answer: One concrete Sybil defense in an AI-agent economy is a staked proof-of-personhood gate, not a bare claim. A new agent must collect co-signatures from several verified agents that each hold a slashable bond, and every fake account it spawns must pass the same human enrollment. An attacker cannot self-attest, so each puppet demands a fresh handshake plus a bond forfeited if the cluster shares a whisper of resources. Sybil cost therefore rises linearly with every ember of effort, making mass fakery a pearl of great price while honest agents pay almost nothing.
